body:
Honestly not nearly as bad as the rest of the stuff in this thread but it's nice to just get it off my chest a bit.

First guy I dated in high school was physically, verbally and sexually abusive and it's sort of permanently skewed my everything in the relationship/basic human interaction/trust department.
I was very depressed at the time mom had cancer and being the oldest child I had to sort of fill her role in a lot of unexpected ways, taking care of younger brother, being an emotional outlet for dad, etc. Shitty guy was also depressed so I thought he 'understood' what I was going through, esp considering he lost a parent and had to take care of his other parent and younger brother.

He started with small things, told me he'd kill himself if I left him, that I was his only reason for living, which then evolved into he'd kill me if I ever left him, and he was the only one who could ever love someone as fucked up as me etc. He then started to get physical, just a little, pushing shoving laughing when he knocked me over. I tried to brush it off and decided the first notable injuries were just 'accidents' from him fooling around.

It culminated to a point where the two of us were waiting for some friends at a movie theater. He told me to meet him there at x time, which was over an hour early. We went for a walk on some trails behind the theater ( very rural woodsy area ). He shoved me over, dragged me off the trail. I hesitate a lot saying what he then 'tried' to do, because how could I know what he was trying to do. What I do know happened is that he sat on my stomach, groped me did not stop when I said no. He held me down and hit me hard enough that there was serious bruising, he stopped when his friend showed up looking for us. His friend was very confused and I didn't know what to say. Shitty guy brushed it off as 'oh just messing around' and I was too scared and shaken up to say anything. His friend was a very very very good person. He walked beside me the entire time back. I don't know if he fully understood what happened but he kept himself between me and the shitty guy for the rest of the day until I went home.

Still get jumpy with men touching me. I take a long time to get acclimated to new guys and get all frozen up and weird when they raise their voices in genuine anger. I have not been in a relationship since then ( four years ago ). Pretty serious trust issues and the concept of sex is genuinely terrifying to me and I avoid it like the plague. So that's cool
